subtitulo: Indicative estimate of the sale price of a home in Madrid

arranque.reposo: > Instance asleep, waking up (may take ~1 min)
arranque.sin_conexion: > No response from the API. Will retry on submit.
arranque.en_cola: > Request queued: waiting for the API...
arranque.rechazado: > The API rejected the request. Check the marked fields.

formulario.no_aplica: Floor, lift and exterior/interior do not apply to houses.

resultado.vacio: Fill in the form and press estimate.
resultado.aviso: Indicative estimate based on Idealista Madrid listings from 2025. Not an official valuation.

a.lectura: Each bar is a quintile of actual price in the test set: band MAE / band median price. The marked band is the one your estimate falls in.

b.titulo: Actual vs predicted price (test, log scale)
b.lectura: Each dot is a test home. On the diagonal, a perfect prediction. The horizontal line is your estimate.
b.resumen: {viviendas} test homes: actual vs predicted price, on a log scale.

c.lectura: Share of use of each feature in the final model.

d.lectura: Mean absolute error at each modelling step, cross-validated; the last point, on the test set.

modelo.que_es: A ==CatBoost== model (gradient boosting on decision trees) trained on ==listings of homes for sale in Madrid published on Idealista in 2025==. It combines {arboles} trees of depth {profundidad} and uses {variables} features: floor area, district, neighbourhood, property type, floor, lift, exterior or interior, bathrooms, bedrooms and {indicadores} indicators extracted from the listing.
modelo.precision: On {viviendas} test homes the model did not see during training: ==MAE {mae}==, RMSE {rmse}, ==R² {r2}==. The error depends on the price: ==between {error_min} and {error_max}== up to €{umbral}M and =={error_lujo}== above.
modelo.limitaciones: It only covers the city of Madrid ({distritos} districts and {barrios} neighbourhoods) and reflects the 2025 market. The dataset was limited in its columns. As much information as possible was extracted following best practices. This is the fairest model we can offer with that data.
modelo.autoria: Model by ==Ramiro Caruso and Ana Manzanares==; the exploratory data analysis is by Ana. This web service is by ==Ramiro Caruso==.

errores.BATHROOMS_ZERO: Bathrooms cannot be 0. If unknown, tick "Don't know".
errores.VALUE_NOT_IN_CATALOG: Value not available. Pick one from the list.
errores.BARRIO_NOT_IN_ZONE: That neighbourhood is not in the chosen district.
errores.MODEL_NOT_LOADED: The model is not loaded yet. Try again in a few seconds.
